Короткі відповіді, so do I і neither do: Short answers, so do I and neither do I
Як відповісти коротко і природно: Yes, I: How to answer briefly and naturally: Yes, I do instead of just Yes, So do I for “me too”, Neither can I for “me neither”. Plus I think so, I hope not and how to disagree politely.
Коротка відповідь на питання: Yes, I do: A short answer to a question: Yes, I do / No, she isn’t
«У тебе є домашня тварина?» «Так, є.»: “Do you have a pet?” “Yes, I do.”
Я теж (на стверджувальне речення): So +: Me too (after a positive sentence): So + auxiliary + I
Я теж ні (на заперечне речення): Neither: Me neither (after a negative sentence): Neither + auxiliary + I
«Я не люблю фільми жахів.» «А я люблю!»: “I don’t like horror films.” “Oh, I do!”
Відповідь-думка: I think so / I hope not: An opinion answer: I think so / I hope not
Yes, + займенник + допоміжне (do / does: Yes, + pronoun + auxiliary (do / does / did / am / is / are / was / have / can / will). No contractions.
So + допоміжне + підмет. Допоміжне те са: So + auxiliary + subject. Use the same auxiliary as in the first sentence; if there isn’t one, use do / does / did.
Neither (або Nor) + допоміжне без not +: Neither (or Nor) + auxiliary without not + subject
У короткій стверджувальній відповіді не: In a positive short answer we don’t contract: Yes, I am, Yes, it is, Yes, we have. Contractions are only possible in the negative: No, I’m not, No, it isn’t.
Neither I can і неправильний час: Neither I can and the wrong tense
Після so / neither порядок як у питанні:: After so / neither the word order is like a question: the auxiliary first, then the subject. And the auxiliary is in the same tense: went → did, have seen → have, was → was.
Neither уже означає «теж ні», тому дієсл: Neither already means “not either”, so the verb after it is positive: Neither do I, Neither can I. Neither don’t I and Neither can’t I are wrong.
Шпаргалка: яке допоміжне брати: Cheat sheet: which auxiliary to use
Дивимося на перше речення. Якщо там є be: Look at the first sentence. If it has be, an auxiliary or a modal (am, was, have, can, will, would), repeat it. If it has just a main verb (like, plays, went), use do / does / did. Table: what is in the first sentence, “me too”, “me neither”.
Раунд 1. Форми: Yes, I do і No, she isn’: Round 1. Forms: Yes, I do and No, she isn’t
The question has Do, so the answer is Yes, I do. We don’t repeat like, and am doesn’t fit a question with do.
Питання з Is, тому No, he isn’t. Допоміж: The question has Is, so No, he isn’t. The auxiliary from the question goes into the answer.
Питання з Can, тому No, I can’t. don’t і: The question has Can, so No, I can’t. don’t and am not don’t answer can, and couldn’t would be about the past.
Yes, we are: у стверджувальній короткій: Yes, we are: no contraction in a positive short answer. were would be about the past.
Питання з Did, тому Yes, I did. do було: The question has Did, so Yes, I did. do would be about the present.
Питання з Has, тому No, she hasn’t. Інші: The question has Has, so No, she hasn’t. The other auxiliaries are not from this question.
The question has Does (he), so Yes, he does.
Were you ...? → No, I wasn’t: з I вживає: Were you ...? → No, I wasn’t: with I we use was. didn’t doesn’t go with be.
Питання з Will, заперечна коротка відпов: The question has Will, a negative short answer: No, she won’t (will not).
Yes, it is. Скорочення Yes, it’s у корот: Yes, it is. The contraction Yes, it’s is impossible in a short answer.
The question has Do, so No, they don’t.
Have you got ...? → Yes, I have. Скороче: Have you got ...? → Yes, I have. The contraction ’ve is impossible in a positive short answer.
The question has Was, so No, it wasn’t.
Питання з Does, тому No, she doesn’t. do: The question has Does, so No, she doesn’t. don’t doesn’t go with she.
Питання з Are, тому Yes, they are. Без с: The question has Are, so Yes, they are. No contraction they’re.
Питання з Could (минуле), тому Yes, I co: The question has Could (past), so Yes, I could.
Have you ...? і відповідь No, тому No, I: Have you ...? and the answer is No, so No, I haven’t.
Питання з Did, тому No, he didn’t. Інші: The question has Did, so No, he didn’t. The other auxiliaries are from a different tense.
Питання з Is, тому Yes, he is. does і pl: The question has Is, so Yes, he is. does and plays don’t answer is.
Питання з Can, тому Yes, it can. Без -s:: The question has Can, so Yes, it can. No -s: a modal doesn’t change.
Раунд 2. So do I і Neither do I: Round 2. So do I and Neither do I
love у Present Simple без допоміжного, т: love is Present Simple with no auxiliary, so we use do: So do I. does doesn’t go with I.
The first sentence has am, so So am I.
Після neither дієслово без not: Neither: After neither the verb has no not: Neither can I. Neither can’t I would be a double negative.
don’t like → Neither do I. Після neither: don’t like → Neither do I. No not after neither, so not don’t.
went: Past Simple, so So did I.
haven’t seen → Neither have I. Після nei: haven’t seen → Neither have I. No not after neither, and did and do are from a different tense.
wasn’t → Neither was I. Без not після ne: wasn’t → Neither was I. No not after neither.
plays (she) у Present Simple, тому So do: plays (she) is Present Simple, so So does Ira. do doesn’t go with Ira (she).
I’ll = I will, so So will I.
I’m not → Neither am I. am not з neither: I’m not → Neither am I. am not with neither makes a double negative.
I’ve finished = Present Perfect, тому So: I’ve finished = Present Perfect, so So have I.
was → So was I. were не підходить до I,: was → So was I. were doesn’t go with I, and did doesn’t replace be.
На заперечне речення відповідаємо Me nei: After a negative sentence we answer Me neither. Me too only after a positive one.
I’d like = I would like, тому So would I: I’d like = I would like, so So would I.
На стверджувальне речення: Me too! Me ne: After a positive sentence: Me too! Me neither only after a negative, and we don’t say Me also.
mine = my parents (вони), тому Neither d: mine = my parents (they), so Neither do mine. No not after neither.
I’m not going → Neither am I.
works (she), тому So does her sister. is: works (she), so So does her sister. is doesn’t replace a main verb.
Раунд 3. Коли вживати: згода, незгода, д: Round 3. When to use them: agreeing, disagreeing, opinions
Перше речення стверджувальне, згода: So: The first sentence is positive, agreeing: So do I. Neither only after a negative.
Перше речення заперечне (didn’t), тому N: The first sentence is negative (didn’t), so Neither did I.
Незгода: на заперечення відповідаємо ств: Disagreeing: we answer a negative with a positive: I do!
Незгода з love: I don’t. am not не відпо: Disagreeing with love: I don’t. am not doesn’t match a main verb.
Бажання, щоб дощу не було: I hope not. I: A wish that it won’t rain: I hope not. I think so not is wrong, and I don’t not and I do not make no sense here.
Людина знає лише дві мови, тобто не пого: The person only speaks two languages, so they disagree: I can’t.
Питання з Did, тому Yes, I did. Yes, I e: The question has Did, so Yes, I did. Yes, I enjoyed without an object is incomplete.
never = заперечення, has been → Neither: never = negative, has been → Neither have I (with I it’s have, not has).
Незгода з Present Perfect: I haven’t. di: Disagreeing with Present Perfect: I haven’t. didn’t and don’t are from a different tense.
Стійкий вираз: I think so. I think it /: A fixed phrase: I think so. We don’t say I think it / that / yes.
walk у Present Simple, Lily = she, тому: walk is Present Simple, Lily = she, so So does Lily.
Бажання: I hope so! I am so і I do so ту: A wish: I hope so! I am so and I do so make no sense here.
Незгода в минулому: Ben loved → I didn’t: Disagreeing in the past: Ben loved → I didn’t.
На жаль, ні: I’m afraid not. I’m afraid: Unfortunately not: I’m afraid not. I’m afraid no is wrong.
Незгода з заперечним реченням: I am! Без: Disagreeing with a negative sentence: I am! No contraction I’m.
is learning → So is my cousin. Neither т: is learning → So is my cousin. Neither only after a negative.
Стійкий вираз: I don’t think so. I don’t: A fixed phrase: I don’t think so. I don’t think not would be a double negative.
I’d love = I would love, тому So would I: I’d love = I would love, so So would I.
Yes, I am: у стверджувальній короткій ві: Yes, I am: no contraction in a positive short answer, and normal word order.
Після neither спочатку допоміжне, потім: After neither the auxiliary comes first, then the subject, with no not: Neither can I.
Після neither без not: Neither do I. Nei: No not after neither: Neither do I. Neither don’t I is wrong.
saw: Past Simple, тому So did I. Дієслов: saw: Past Simple, so So did I. We don’t repeat saw, and was doesn’t replace a main verb.
Yes, it is. Yes, it’s у короткій відпові: Yes, it is. Yes, it’s is impossible in a short answer.
Neither am I: спочатку am, потім I, і бе: Neither am I: am first, then I, and no not. do doesn’t replace be.
Have you got ...? → No, I haven’t.

На заперечне речення: Me neither (або Ne: After a negative sentence: Me neither (or Neither do I). Me too and So do I only after a positive one.
has finished, і Tom = he, тому So has To: has finished, and Tom = he, so So has Tom.
Питання з Does, тому Yes, she does. driv: The question has Does, so Yes, she does. We don’t use drives in a short answer.
never = заперечення, would → Neither wou: never = negative, would → Neither would I.

The question has Did, so Yes, they did.
A fixed phrase: I don’t think so.

Choose the sentence that sounds right.
Сподіваюся, що ні: I hope not. Вирази I: Hoping it won’t: I hope not. I don’t hope so and I hope no are wrong.
Yes, she can. Модальне can не отримує -s: Yes, she can. The modal can never takes -s.
was late → So was Ben. did не замінює be: was late → So was Ben. did doesn’t replace be, and were doesn’t go with Ben.
Перше речення заперечне, тому Neither do: The first sentence is negative, so Neither does my cat.
The question has Does, so Yes, she does.
got: Past Simple, so So did Ira.
Have you ...? і відповідь No: No, I have: Have you ...? and the answer is No: No, I haven’t.

Незгода з loves (he): Her brother doesn’: Disagreeing with loves (he): Her brother doesn’t.
The question has Were, so No, they weren’t.
never робить речення заперечним, тому Me: never makes the sentence negative, so Me neither.

Disagreeing with a negative: I do.
Питання з Is, тому Yes, it is, без скоро: The question has Is, so Yes, it is, with no contraction.
isn’t working → Neither is mine. does не: isn’t working → Neither is mine. does doesn’t replace be.

The question has Has, so No, he hasn’t.
